Signs of the World

Stairs

History

In the 1970s, designers working on travel pictograms for the US Department of Transportation debated whether the stairs symbol needed a person. They left the figure out, letting the steps speak for themselves.

Adoption

The stepped line reads as stairs almost anywhere, though some signs add a figure, an arrow or the word itself.
